title: AS2 compiler: global duplicateMovieClip()/removeMovieClip() fall through to ActionCallFunction — should emit ActionCloneSprite (0x24)/ActionRemoveSprite (0x25)
description:
In AS2 timeline scripts, the global forms of duplicateMovieClip(target, newname, depth) and removeMovieClip(target) must emit ActionCloneSprite (0x24) and ActionRemoveSprite (0x25) opcodes respectively.

Current behaviour: both fall through to ActionCallFunction, which fails at runtime because Ruffle's AVM1 global scope does not register these as top-level function objects (only as MovieClip instance methods via globals/movie_clip.rs).

Note: The MC method form mc.duplicateMovieClip(newname, depth) correctly emits ActionCallMethod — that path is handled and works (task 0875, done). This task is about the GLOBAL function form only.

ActionCloneSprite (0x24) stack protocol per SWF spec:
  pops: depth (top), new name (middle), target path (deepest)
  push order for duplicateMovieClip(target, newname, depth):
    push target (deepest), push newname, push depth (top), emit 0x24

ActionRemoveSprite (0x25) stack protocol:
  pops: target path
  push order: push target, emit 0x25

Fix in packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts compileCallExpr():
1. Add 'duplicateMovieClip', 'removeMovieClip' to the string-pool exclusion list.
2. Add built-in handlers:
   - duplicateMovieClip(target, newname, depth): push target, push newname, push depth, emit 0x24
   - removeMovieClip(target): push target, emit 0x25
3. Add tests.

References: ruffle/swf/src/avm1/opcode.rs (CloneSprite=0x24, RemoveSprite=0x25), ruffle/core/src/avm1/activation.rs.
